failure_prediction.score_interpretation: Model score; not a guaranteed real-world failure probability.

fault_classification.limitation: Single-label classifier; cannot independently represent simultaneous faults.

multilabel_fault_classification.score_interpretation: Random Forest scores; not guaranteed calibrated probabilities.

final_diagnosis.severity_reason: No equipment fault or risk alert was raised.

sensor_quality.explanation: Sensor quality was not independently assessed. Historical sensor readings are required for stronger noise and drift detection.

recommendations: Continue routine monitoring and scheduled maintenance.
final_diagnosis.decision_policy: Transparent rule-based synthesis; not a learned or independently validated severity model.

limitations: The XGBoost model was trained on the UCI AI4I 2020 dataset.
The anomaly detector and fault classifiers were trained on synthetic industrial simulator data.
The multi-label fault model learns controlled synthetic fault-injection signatures.
Model scores are not guaranteed calibrated probabilities.
Sensor quality is not independently established from a single reading.
Severity is assigned using transparent engineering rules that require further validation.
The system is a research prototype, not a certified industrial safety system.
